mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES continues to rebound from the recent trough, weekday footfall should recover first in nearby retail and recreation venues, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks relative to the prior four-week average.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays flat or declines over the next 28 days while WORKPLACES does not recover above the t-1w level.

mechanism_narrative: A higher RESIDENTIAL share signals more people staying home, which suppresses discretionary outings and pushes RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days even though RESIDENTIAL remains at or above the recent 8.6 to 9.7 range.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT stops falling and turns up, access costs to shopping districts ease within one to two weeks, so RETAIL_REC should improve after a short lag.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT crosses above its t-1w value after at least two consecutive down weeks
failure_condition: TRANSIT improves but RETAIL_REC does not rise within 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT indicates more commuting and more downtown circulation, which should lift RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks more than either series alone.
failure_condition: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both improve but RETAIL_REC remains below the prior four-week mean.

mechanism_narrative: A renewed rise in PARKS mobility diverts trips toward outdoor leisure and away from indoor shopping, reducing RETAIL_REC over the next one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above its t-1w level after a two-week decline
failure_condition: PARKS rises but RETAIL_REC also rises within 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM and RESIDENTIAL both strengthen together, households are consolidating essential trips at home and local stores, which should suppress discretionary retail visits and keep RETAIL_REC below its prior four-week average.
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM and RESIDENTIAL both rise but RETAIL_REC increases within 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: Under tightening restrictions, simultaneous declines in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES reduce incidental shopping traffic, so RETAIL_REC should fall further over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both fall below their t-1w values for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both decline but RETAIL_REC does not drop below the last four-week mean.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM keeps recovering while PARKS stays weak, consumers are shifting back toward routine errands rather than outdoor leisure, which should raise RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM rises and PARKS remains subdued but RETAIL_REC still declines over 28 days.
